verdict.rationale: Plaid divides data access into separate products (Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions), and its Sandbox endpoint takes a list of 'initial products' when creating Items, which implies developers choose which data products an Item requests. The pack never documents product-scoped consent screens in Link or any explicit data-minimization controls. One community comment says users are not told they may be sharing more than account numbers, which lowers confidence but does not concretely show that developer-side scoping fails. Missing for 10: documentation that Link consent is scoped per product, explicit data-minimization or field-level scope controls, documentation of the production products parameter, and independent corroboration that scoping limits data access.
